stories.h: Coastal flood advisory for Everett, Marysville, Lynnwood shorelines
stories.s: An NWS advisory runs 2 a.m.–5 p.m. Tuesday for Everett/Marysville, south Snohomish and northwest lowlands, with 1.5–2.5 ft of inundation possible at high tide. Higher tides follow Wednesday and Thursday.

stories.h: 30 cats, two dogs rescued from Marysville hoarding home
stories.s: Police removed the animals from a home where ammonia levels triggered a hazmat response and found 12 dead cats. They plan to refer 44 neglect charges against the resident.

coming.h: More king tide flooding possible Wednesday, Thursday
coming.s: NWS flood watches for Everett/Marysville and south Snohomish shorelines run late Tuesday night through Thursday afternoon, with up to 3.5 ft of inundation.
